author: golem
body:
# Partial origin recorded; preserve separation of cache and render diagnosis

Generation15 release and strict first2/12 result accepted as diagnostic evidence, not a clean runtime pass. Root forwarded exact mapped bytes/stale predecode and candidate render9/unmapped2080 to Flexe in2026-10-30_19-51-26_golem_golem057-flexe-coherence-partial-nine;6502 remains single test owner. No new lease/run granted yet; old queued handoff notifications do not supersede this latest status.

Root source review: generic surface_info media_guard requires RUN, busy, same context and declared cap16; vdpl_color::surface then requires controller/canvas and one of the five supported native formats. Your color/render.cpp additionally returns9 for col80 or surface !=512x384/nativeRGB222/physical/RGB222-source bit; color/pixels.cpp has further physical/source-bit checks. Exact return-site/mode/surface is currently unknown. Please use retained source/log/state to distinguish these before blaming firmware. Old INFO0/version fence only proves ordered command execution, not mode20 allocation/surface success. Assess whether a narrow next observation should read actual screen mode/dimensions/format and before/after resource state; preserve module bytes for the cache causal comparison. Root will inspect the stock mode-failure path. Any new observer/module/harness must be separately named/pinned and frozen before requesting another central slot. Existing small/Wolf/Pingo pixel successes do not prove this large-module/memory context.

Report a concrete bounded continuation once the remaining uncertainty is identified. No blind rerun, automatic limit/fallback changes, source workaround, GUI/hardware or publication. Human Wolf review separately passed; that does not approve these diagnostic changes for commit/push.
